title: How to Talk to Anyone, Anytime, Anywhere

questions.q: What formula for achievement does the summary give?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says talent and effort turn a gift into a skill, and skill plus effort into achievement.

questions.q: How does the summary describe talent without hard work?
a: It means little in the long run
It is more valuable than effort
It cannot be improved at all
questions.why: Lesson 1 argues that without consistent work, natural ability counts for very little.

questions.q: Why is listening essential to communication?
a: It is how we learn something new
It lets you plan your reply
questions.why: Lesson 2 says talking teaches us nothing, while listening is how we learn.

questions.q: What kind of questions should a good listener ask?
a: Open-ended rather than yes or no
Yes or no rather than open-ended
questions.why: Lesson 2 recommends open questions that invite the other person to say more.

questions.q: What does the summary say makes work stand out?
questions.why: Lesson 3 calls enthusiasm the driving emotion behind passion and long hours.
